messages:
Ari: quick capture from three onboarding calls today — recurring asks: per-route billing toggle hard to find, lack of simple cost examples, request for team-scoped API keys.
Ari: direct quote: "We spent ages trying to find billing per-route, thought it wasn't enabled" (AtlasHealth).
Bea: which accounts + renewal exposure?
Ari: AtlasHealth (paid, renewal in 3w, flagged), EmberTech (pilot, 2 teams), SolaceAI (trial, security asking about team keys).
Cole: product signal: we can do a quick UX patch — surface the toggle next to route name + add a one-line tooltip linking to cost preview. small effort.
Cole: estimate 1 dev day + 0.5 UX day.
Bea: priority: AtlasHealth is high risk. Recommend outreach + canary UI fix before their renewal call.
Ari: I'll schedule a 15m walkthrough and draft an email template for CSMs.
Bea: also ask billing for a simple cost table (per 10k / 100k tokens) we can paste in docs and the tooltip.
Cole: team API keys is larger (auth + RBAC) 100% backlog for roadmap triage.
Ezra-bot: CS-8234 created: "Onboarding: surface per-route billing toggle + cost-preview + CSM enablement" assigned to Cole, priority P1 for AtlasHealth follow-up, due 72h.
Ari: tagging signals: onboarding-ux, billing-visibility, api-keys-request. I'll paste raw transcript snippets to the ticket and own comms.
Bea: once mock is in, I'll update the renewal tracker and mark AtlasHealth as "blocking: onboarding confusion".
Cole: will post mock tomorrow EOD. small change but likely high impact.
Ari: thanks team 64c happy to share more quotes if needed.
